findings.description: The advertised cross-host loop semantic-equivalence field compares complete host payloads, including different persisted_path strings, so a live run returns false even when the persisted loop state transitions match.
findings.suggestion: Compare only host-neutral loop semantics (created/resumed state, decisions, stop reason, and normalized packet semantics), or omit host-specific paths before comparing; add an assertion that this parity result is true.
